resources.string: A hu athu u ṱanganedzwa milaedza. Khwaṱhisedzani uri burokara yo ṱumanywa nahone yo ḓiṅwalisa (ṱolani Dziburokara kha Mivhekanyo, kana uri thero yayo ya mutheo i fana na vhudzudzanyi haṋu)
A hu na milaedza i fanaho na tshisefi itsho
I a dzinginyea nahone i a lila (nga u kwengweledza, nga vholumu ya alamu) musi sensa ya vhuṋoṱa i tshi swika vhukati ha tshikalo tshayo tsho teaho i tshi khou gonya
Iyi ndi nḓila ine ndivhadzo ya tsevhudzo ya u sheledza ya vhonala ngayo
I khou gonya i tshi fhira vhukati ha tshikalo tshayo tsho teaho – thupha u vula %1$s
%1$s yo swika kha vhuṋoṱa vhu ṱoḓeaho
Ni ḓo ṱoḓa burokara nthihi ya MQTT nga u ṱuku u thoma – engedzani nthihi zwino, kana ni vhuedzedze vhudzudzanyi he na vhu vhulungela kale
